note: This file is a pure configuration file (no callable functions, classes, or APIs). It defines a Mask R-CNN model config with a ResNeXt-101-32x8d backbone using mmengine's read_base pattern. No CLI-invocable code is present.
summarize_config: summarize the Mask R-CNN ResNeXt-101-32x8d FPN configuration for COCO dataset
review_model_backbone: review the ResNeXt-101-32x8d backbone configuration with Caffe2 pretrained weights
review_data_preprocessor: review the data preprocessor settings with Caffe2 mean and std values
build_model_config: build a Mask R-CNN model config using ResNeXt-101-32x8d backbone with FPN
refactor_norm_cfg: refactor the BatchNorm2d normalization config to enable gradient updates
